The '''Tharin sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Scandium Team]] operated in the sector.

==History==
Around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], events in the Tharin sector allowed [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Bakki Sourthol]] to obtain important information about threats to the Rebel Alliance. Due to this, he was temporarily relieved from his duties in [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] so he could report to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Tharin sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />

By the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Falloon]] was the chief accountant for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] in the sector.<ref name="LCaL">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20020221a2|text=Last Call at Leatherback's|int=Last Call at Leatherback's}}</ref>
